snippet.title: 【OFFICIAL TRAILER】Dead Before Work: The Commute
snippet.description:
If you like absurd physics and ragdoll chaos, this is right up your alley! 

Our comedy game "Dead Before Work: The Commute" just launched today!

• On impact, press Jump for SLOW-MO, then hit Jump again to LAUNCH yourself for extra score & cash!
• Export CCTV-style replay GIFs of your funniest crashes!
• Full Level Editor: Basically 'Mario Maker' for a 3D Salaryman! Share via Steam Workshop or instant copy-paste codes.
• Unlock traps, customizable costumes, board-game XP progression & global leaderboards!
• Gamepad & vibration supported for gameplay! (Mouse required for options menu)
•  Streamer Friendly Music (All Music are safe to stream)

Hope you enjoy the chaos and feature our game!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4142180/DEAD_BEFORE_WORK_THE_COMMUTE/
